title: Conditional κ = 7.24733001963261·10⁻⁴: 695 collective response-kernel entries (per-entry cuts, entrances of any dimension) on #276's gen4 word, composed with #279's descent retiming (+0.258% over #276)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.24733001963261·10⁻⁴: 695 collective response-kernel entries with per-entry cuts on #276's gen4 word, composed with #279's 880-gate descent retiming (+0.258% over #276, +0.161% over #279)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen4-collective-kernels/` (renamed from the first version of this PR, which carried 424 line pairs at 7.23943728615132·10⁻⁴), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 724733001963261/10¹⁸ = 7.24733001963261·10⁻⁴**, the bit side binding (bit coarse 7.25259·10⁻⁴, complex 7.47455·10⁻⁴). This is the standalone construction in #276's own Python pipeline; #283/#284 compose further levers (terminal sinks, transported entrances, early restorations, target squares) in Dugongue's native pipeline and stand above it — the contribution here is the collective families themselves, verified in #276's chain.

## Result

#276 (DreamingOfClouds) introduced the gen4 bit word; none of the entrance levers developed on the #249 word (#254–#275) had been carried to it. This package carries response kernels there, generalised: as a stage of #276's own six-int transcript pipeline, after #279's descent stage (vendored unchanged), 695 entries — 416 twin pairs on lines (e = 1, #254/#268's mechanism), 24 twin pairs entering on their full 16-dimensional first-frame intersection (each worth more than ten line pairs), and 255 multi-donor families (208 quadruples, 47 triples: the pivot's response is the XOR of its donors', all members share a nondegenerate common entrance of dimension 1–18, 59 donors serve several entries along nested chains; #259/#272's collective kernels).

| one invocation, m = 120 | #276 | #279 | this package |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| entrances (ranks) | 2,466 (20, 21) | 2,466 | **3,161** (1 × 476, 2 × 93, 4 × 29, 5–18 × 97, 20 × 2,200, 21 × 266) |
| one-stage paid rank mass | 425,742 | — | **423,714** |
| literal stock, 60 replicas / banks per stage | 1,283,035 / 172,127 | — | **1,277,965 / 171,113** |
| κ | 7.22869827347495·10⁻⁴ | 7.23571590007464·10⁻⁴ | **7.24733001963261·10⁻⁴** |

* **Per-entry cuts.** On gen4 the compensation reads are chronological: each plain dirty helper's zero-frame reads precede its first other use (by at least 41,247 records), so there is no single prefix cut; each entry is cut at the later of its members' last zero-frame reads, bound by content. The twin census of the 13,944 plain helpers finds 1,568 twin classes and 568 pairs with a nondegenerate common line; the collective census enumerates the low-weight F₂ circuits of the 12,352 distinct responses (3,158 triangles, 23,421 quadruples), keeps those with a nondegenerate common entrance in all first frames, prices them under the deficit-fixed ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(120/r); quintuples are never net-positive) and packs them greedily with shared-donor chains. Total entrance rank 2,028.
* **Rewrite** (eumemic's #268 `kernel_transform.py`, generalised): the pivot's compensation reads are deleted (12,520 in all), it enters at E, each donor pays its shear at E after the cut and the inverse at the full frame (2,316 ADDs); one-stage paid rank mass 425,742 → 423,714.
* **Checks.** `kernel_transform.replay` runs every formal column (19,930) forward and inverse on the emitted word, rejects both omitted-gate controls (2,713 / 1,061 wrong rows), checks the prefix relation (pivot response = XOR of the donors' responses) on the literal prefix for every entry, rebuilds the stream frame paths independently of the MOVEs and checks the nested donor chains; then every #276 stage runs fresh — virtual, raw, bit, scalar (eleven controls), primes (every entrance basis factored; 664 charts ≤ 576 factors, normalizer bound 815), banks (every residual width r tiled by (r⁴, 4³⁰⁻ʳ) banks, 20 pattern kinds, every bank width 120 and full; selector calls 963,705,578,400 < 2⁴⁰), complex, math, finite — with ten omitted-stage negative controls, and the geometry stage samples an actual entrance basis for every new rank. Every #276 literal the rewrite changes is a recomputed pinned value in `expected/kernel-pins.json`, asserted by `pins.pin`; none is dropped (`KERNEL-PROOF.md` lists all of them).

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen4-collective-kernels/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen4-collective-kernels/verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-collective-kernels-verification   # about 8 minutes; not under -I
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen4-collective-kernels/gen4bit/producer/regenerate.py --work /tmp/gen4-regeneration

`verify.py` is #276's with the kernel stage required and κ pinned (`PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN4_KERNEL_PAIRS_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`). The workflow runs both commands on Ubuntu with Python 3.11 and 3.13.

## Scope and limits

* Same conditional status as #276 and the source527 lineage (finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses; no Lean certificate). #279 is a draft at the time of writing: its stage is vendored unchanged and its correctness claims are inherited, not re-proved. One composition detail: the used-frame inventory passed to the prime check keeps the inherited producer inventory (a retimed gate's former frame is still a required base of the virtual word), a superset; #279's own package builds that inventory from actual uses only, which may be why its full replay is still pending.
* Not composed here: terminal sinks, transported entrances, early restorations and target squares (#280/#283); #284 adds 91 of these families on #283's word. Not exploited: cleanup sandwiches (gen4 helpers are compute/read/uncompute nodes with mirrored cleanup, so none exists), residual widths 3 and 4, the admissible pairs that are net-negative under φ.
* Diff against #276's package: `kernel_transform.py`, `kernel-selection.json`, `pins.py`, `expected/kernel-pins.json`, `KERNEL-PROOF.md`, `descent_transform.py` and `descent-selection.json` (#279), modifications to `portable_bit.py`, `raw_ledger.py`, `code/global_lowering.py`, `code/geometry527.py`, `bank_template.py` (the (r⁴, 4³⁰⁻ʳ) patterns), `bank_check.py`, `scalar_check.py`, `prime_check.py`, `math_check.py`, `finite_check.py`, `verify.py`; `discovery/`; this package's notes (#276's kept as `README-PR276.md`, `PROOF-PR276.md`).

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The gen4 word and its package are DreamingOfClouds' (#276); the descent retiming stage is rohanarun's (#279); the kernel stage adapts eumemic's #268 (its mechanism is Dugongue's #254/#259/#272, the tiling rule #283's); the five-stage completed-bank package is eumemic's source527 lineage (#251/#249/#244/#210) on hcg890's #234 layout, with Jacob Sussman's five-stage construction, Evan McKinney's and rohanarun's banks, ikeboy's complex helper and icekylinx's paired cubes. This package contributes the per-entry-cut censuses and selection, the generalised stage (any entrance dimension, multi-donor families, shared donors), the bank tiling for every residual width at 60 replicas, the per-rank geometry sample, the re-pinned checks, the composition with #279, and the discovery scripts.
